IGUI_MQ_Admin_LayoutError: This page could not be drawn. See console.txt.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_NoReply: The server did not answer within 10 seconds. Press Reload to check the result.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_TooBig: Too many changes at once (over 32 KB). Apply them in smaller batches.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_Applied: Applied (change #%1). You can undo it on the History tab.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_KeepUnlocked: Achievements already unlocked are not taken back.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_ErrRange: Must be from %1 to %2 (whole numbers where counts are asked).
IGUI_MQ_Admin_ErrIncreasing: Each threshold must be higher than the tier before.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_ErrPtsCount: Give as many point values as thresholds.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_ErrMinMax: The minimum cannot be larger than the maximum.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_ErrMilestones: Milestone days must increase from one to the next.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_ErrDate: Write dates as YYYY-MM-DD; the end cannot be before the start.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_ErrPast: This event would already be over.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_HistoryNote: The last 20 changes are kept. Undo writes the old values back and is recorded as a change too.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_FileNote: config.json in Zomboid/Lua/MinidoracatQuest/<server>/ on the server holds the panel settings that differ from the defaults (events and the season length are not in it). Edit and save it: the change applies within about a minute and is recorded in this history. Applying or undoing in the panel rewrites the file. A file with an error is not applied and the current settings stay. defaults.json in the same folder lists every default value; status.json holds the result of the last read.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_FileOk: Last synced %1: config.json matches the settings in effect.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_FileBad: config.json (read %1) has an error and was not applied; the current settings stay. %2
IGUI_MQ_Admin_FileIo: Could not read or write config.json (%1, %2). Check the folder's permissions and free disk space on the server.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_DiffNote: Quick difficulty changes thresholds and quest targets only, not points.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_BatchHelp: Batch edits go into the pending changes. Press Preview changes below to check and apply them.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_Skipped: %1 achievements were left unchanged (top threshold over 1,000,000,000 or already 10 tiers).
IGUI_MQ_Admin_InDraft: Added to the pending changes. Press Preview changes to apply.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_NewAch: + New achievement from an existing stat
IGUI_MQ_Admin_NewAchHelp: Pick an existing stat, then enter a name, thresholds and points (comma separated, the same count, up to 10).
IGUI_MQ_Admin_PoolHelp: Each template: on/off, target range (min - max) and points.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_F_streak_need: Quests per day for a streak day
IGUI_MQ_Admin_SeasonPreviewBody: This season will settle at %1; season %2 starts %3.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_SeasonLengthNote: 7 to 180 days. A new length applies to this season right away; the new settlement must be at least 24 hours away.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_SeasonApplied: Season length is now %1 days; it settles at %2.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_ReviewNone: The list appears here when the season ends.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_ReviewNote: Accounts with anomalies are only marked, not excluded. Excluding needs a reason. Without action, rewards are paid from the frozen list 24 hours after the freeze. Paying asks once more.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_ExcludeAsk: Exclude %1 (%2 points) from this season's rewards?
IGUI_MQ_Admin_PayAsk: Pay season %1 rewards to %2 accounts (%3 excluded)? This cannot be undone.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_RewardsNote: Reward points only go to the balance and do not count toward rank.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_NoEconomy: The economy mod is not installed or not ready, so points cannot be exchanged.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_Warn_over_cap_Body: The economy mod gives this mod a daily limit of %1; exchanges above it wait until the next day. Raise the limit on the economy admin's Integration sources page, or lower the rate.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_Warn_cap_zero_Body: The economy mod gives this mod a daily limit of 0, so every exchange waits in the queue. Set a limit on the economy admin's Integration sources page.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_Warn_disabled_Body: The economy mod has turned this mod off as a source, so exchanges wait in the queue. Turn it back on on the economy admin's Integration sources page.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_Warn_unknown_Body: The economy mod is installed but the daily limit it gives this mod could not be read. Check it on the economy admin's Integration sources page (the default 0 sends every exchange to the queue).
IGUI_MQ_Admin_ExEcUsed: Paid out by the economy today
IGUI_MQ_Admin_EventsNote: Multiplies daily and weekly quest points only. At most 3 at a time.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_EventsMax: 3 events are already running or scheduled.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_RevokeAsk: Account %1: revoke %3 tier(s) of %2, down to %4.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_HideAsk: Account %1: remove from every leaderboard (1 account). The data is kept.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_UnhideAsk: Put account %1 back on the leaderboards?
IGUI_MQ_Admin_DangerNote: Revoking and removal are recorded with your name and the reason.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_AnomNote: Each stat has a per-minute limit (120 zombie kills by default, for example). Going over it within one minute records one entry: the excess is not counted, so it does not advance quests or achievements. Normal play rarely gets there; mass farming or scripts can. The season settlement list marks these accounts but does not exclude them. "View" shows that account's points and achievements above, where you can revoke achievements or remove it from the leaderboards.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_BalanceNote: Last 7 days. Completion under 30%% is flagged too hard, over 90%% too easy.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_TownsNote: Towns count for the explore achievements. Turn a built-in town off to stop counting visits there.

IGUI_MQ_UI_AnonNote: Your rank still counts; other players see "Anonymous survivor" instead of your name and title, but admins can still see who you are. This only applies to this mod's leaderboards and notices; your title over your head and in chat still shows.
IGUI_MQ_UI_BoardEmptyBody: Finish daily quests or unlock achievements to show up here.
IGUI_MQ_UI_BoardEmptySeason: Nobody is on this season's board yet
IGUI_MQ_UI_BoardEmptyTotal: Nobody is on this board yet
IGUI_MQ_UI_BoardErrorBody: The server did not answer within 5 seconds. Press Refresh to try again.
IGUI_MQ_UI_BoardNotRanked: You are not on this board yet.
IGUI_MQ_UI_BoardTotalOnly: This board only has an all-time ranking.
IGUI_MQ_UI_ExAfter: Balance after: %1 points. Ranks use points earned, so exchanging does not change your rank.
IGUI_MQ_UI_ExDayLimit: You can only exchange %1 more points today.
IGUI_MQ_UI_ExLeft: You can still exchange %1 points today
IGUI_MQ_UI_ExNoPoints: You do not have enough points.
IGUI_MQ_UI_ExNoReplyBody: Press Ask again to get the result. Asking again never exchanges twice.
IGUI_MQ_UI_ExOff: Exchanging is turned off right now.
IGUI_MQ_UI_ExQueuedBody: The economy's allowance for today is used up; it will be paid automatically.
IGUI_MQ_UI_ExQueuedBodyN: Today's exchange allowance is used up. Your %1 points are held and paid automatically after the next reset.
IGUI_MQ_UI_ExQueuedNote: %1 points are queued: the economy's allowance for today is used up; they will be paid automatically.
IGUI_MQ_UI_ExRateNote: Survivor coins per point: %1 (set by the server).
IGUI_MQ_UI_ExRefusedBody: Your economy account cannot receive coins right now; %1 points were returned. Please contact an admin.
IGUI_MQ_UI_GoalRule: When the goal is reached, everyone who contributed %1 or more gets +%2 points.
IGUI_MQ_UI_ModOptionsNote: The toolbar entry, server-wide unlock notices, the tracker panel and titles above heads and in chat can be turned off in the game's Options > MODS > Quests & Achievements.
IGUI_MQ_UI_NeedFramework: Quests & Achievements needs a newer Minidoracat UI framework.
IGUI_MQ_UI_NewbieStep_4: Leave your starting town carrying a weapon
IGUI_MQ_UI_NoQuests: No quests yet. They appear at the next reset.
IGUI_MQ_UI_NoState: The server has not sent your quest data yet.
IGUI_MQ_UI_ParticipationLeft: %1 more points for the participation reward
IGUI_MQ_UI_PointsNote: Used for ranking and unlocking titles.
IGUI_MQ_UI_PointsNoteEx: Exchanging only spends the balance; ranks use points earned.
IGUI_MQ_UI_PrefsRule: Each day 2 quests come from the themes you pick and 1 from all themes. Points depend on the quest, not on the theme.
IGUI_MQ_UI_PrefsWhen: If today's quests were already made, the change applies from the next reset.
IGUI_MQ_UI_RecordsError: Could not load your records (no answer within 5 seconds).
IGUI_MQ_UI_RecordsNote: "This life" resets when the character dies; "All-time" is kept across characters and is what achievements count.
IGUI_MQ_UI_RewardNote: Season reward points go to your balance only and do not count toward ranks. The top 10 come from the overall board.
IGUI_MQ_UI_SeasonPayingBody: Rewards arrive on their own; watch your notifications.
IGUI_MQ_UI_SeasonReviewBody: Ranks are frozen while rewards are confirmed. They are paid within 24 hours; you do not need to do anything.
IGUI_MQ_UI_SharedNote: The server-wide quest is one per day, the same for everyone, and cannot be swapped.
IGUI_MQ_UI_StreakRule: A day counts when you finish %1 of the 4 quests. You may miss %2 day(s) per week.
IGUI_MQ_UI_ToastAchvManyBody: %1. Open Quests & Achievements to see them all.
